description: An expander for MiniLab that follows the MiniLab 3's knobs, wheels and aftertouch while one particular pad is held, so each pad gives a whole second set of controls

outputs.text: Carries 5V while this expander's pad is held on the controller and 0V the rest of the time
The velocity the pad was struck with, 0V to 10V, set at the moment the pad goes down and held until the next press
Follows the controller's pitch bend wheel while this expander's pad is held, -5V fully down, 0V at rest and 5V fully up, and it holds its last value when the pad is let go
Follows the controller's modulation wheel while this expander's pad is held, 0V to 10V, and it holds its last value when the pad is let go
Follows the pressure on this expander's pad after it has been struck, 0V to 10V, and it is read whether or not the pad counts as held
The value piled up by turning that numbered knob on the controller while this expander's pad is held: each click of the encoder moves it by the turn speed set on this jack's own menu

notes: this module does nothing on its own: it belongs to the right of a MiniLab, with other MiniPads allowed between, and the MiniLab hands it the MIDI driver, device and channel
the number shown on the panel is this expander's place in the chain, and it is the number of the controller pad that drives it; two dashes mean no MiniLab was found to the left
while this expander's pad is held the MiniLab itself stops following the knobs and wheels, and they come out here instead; let the pad go and every jack here holds its last value
menu: Slew limit — a slider on each output jack's own right-click menu, setting how long that jack takes to reach a new value, from none up to 2 seconds
Mode: 0V:1V, 0V:5V, 0V:10V, -1V:1V, -5V:5V, -10V:10V — on each output jack's own right-click menu, setting the voltage range that jack's value is scaled into
Resolution: Two, Three, Four, Five, Eight, Twelve, Low, Medium, High — on a knob jack's own right-click menu, setting how many steps the knob's travel is divided into, two up to 8192
Turn Speed: 1, 2, 10, 1%, 2%, 5%, 10%, 25%, 50%, Toggle — on a knob jack's own right-click menu, setting how far one click of the encoder moves the value
